svg.title: NinaPro DB2: Original Dataset and Paired-Sensor Audit
svg.desc: Original S01 exercise-one archive and sensor field inspection. The middle panel shows where the signal is recorded and how the released source traces align with corrected labels.
svg.text: NINAPRO DB2: ORIGINAL DATASET AND PAIRED-SENSOR AUDIT
Original NinaPro DB2 · S01 exercise E1 · 12 sEMG + 36 acceleration columns · No model fitting
Signal origin: forearm wearable sensor array
Waveform shapes are illustrative; source fields, sample counts and alignment records are from the executed audit.
Original ZIP → selected E1 MATLAB → paired source arrays → corrected annotation audit → traceable outputs
